game.adsBody: Ads appear at the top of the screen. Buy “{removeAds}” once, and they're gone for good. “{support}” thanks you with a short movie. For prices, please check your app store.
game.adsNote: Support isn't a promise to take requests or add features. If you have thoughts or ideas, a review on the store would mean a lot.

storm-volley.card: One-on-one volleyball in a storm. Keep the rally alive and race the lightning
unique: Keep it up, then spike it
In volleyball, the ball never touches the ground. Leap above the high net and smash a spike down.
Long, fun rallies
Rallies keep going, so even first-timers are playing real volleyball right away. The longer they last, the closer the lightning count gets.
Play the lightning
A strike is worth 2 points. Watch the count, mix lobs, bumps, and spikes to time how long the ball stays up, and have it over your opponent's court at 0.

storm-badminton.card: One-on-one badminton in a storm. Ride the wind and work your opponent front to back
unique: Float it short, drive it down
Float a drop shot just over the net, send a clear high to the back, or fire a sharp smash. Work your opponent front to back and make them run.
A shuttle on the wind
The light shuttle rides the wind. The higher the clear, the farther it drifts.
Smash
When the shuttle comes in high, jump and hammer it down.

storm-tennis.card: One-on-one tennis in a storm. The fastest of the series: paint the lines
unique: Pure speed
Even in a storm, the ball flies hard and fast. Hit a high ball with a power shot and it's a smash.
Win with placement
Hit left and right, and drive it where your opponent can't reach.
Bounces and serves
Let the ball bounce once, then hit it back. Toss and serve three ways: fast, normal, or soft.

storm-pickleball.card: One-on-one pickleball in a storm. Kitchen, side-out scoring: real pickleball rules
unique: Real pickleball rules
Side-out scoring, so only the serving side can score. The kitchen, where you can't volley. And the two-bounce rule: the serve and the return must bounce first.
Battles at the net
Dink softly into your opponent's kitchen, then drive the ball that pops up.
From fireworks to a stormy sea
Start in a calm harbor at night, with fireworks overhead, until a storm suddenly rolls in mid-game. The other venue: the deck of a cruise ship on a raging sea.

vollog.statsNote: Choose for each match whether to record {reception}. Teams that don’t track it can record without those fields.
cards: Register jersey numbers, names, and positions, and keep each player’s match records.
Enter data during the match with “{realtime}” or afterward with “{summary}”. Record set scores and individual stats.
See totals for each player, and track growth with trend graphs for all time or a chosen period.
Export stats as images or PDFs on every plan. CSV export is available with Pro.
Share team and match records with another Vollog user as a file. Sending requires Pro; receiving is free.
Pick a color scheme from 8 themes, including {themes}.
